name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && pip3 install --user -r backend/requirements.txt backend/requirements.txt frontend/requirements.txt streamlit

postAttachCommand.server: tmux new-session -d -s dev 'uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'; tmux split-window -h -t dev 'streamlit run frontend/app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0'; tmux attach-session -t dev
